title: AI and inclusive growth through digitally delivered services
discussion_signal: The discussion presents AI and digitally deliverable services as potential sources of inclusive growth, but notes that gains depend on privacy, cybersecurity, competition, governance, and access to interoperable markets. It preserves the tension between technological opportunity and concentration of benefits.
linked_research_question: What infrastructure, governance, and capability conditions determine whether AI-enabled trade produces inclusive rather than concentrated growth?
limits: The source is a 2026 discussion linked to an atlas record titled 2025
Simulation and growth claims are not independently assessed here
LinkedIn discussion is not representative of affected workers or firms
